items.title: Wendy Oxenhorn — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: He just came out for the Madison Square Garden concert with Elton John.

ctx.x: Would you do the British accent for us?

Let me try to get British again, because now I’ve been Country. I’d say: “Hello, so­ and-so. I’m calling from the offices of Mr. Bill Cosby, and he’s very concerned about a musician that you’re possibly considering renting your apartments to. Do you know who this man is? He’s quite extraordinary. He just came out for the Madison Square Garden concert with Elton John. He’s one of the more famous musicians, and Mr. Cosby is terribly worried about him. We want to make sure that he has a place to be. This is a…
